title: Cosmonautics: Deep Air
description: Compatibility bridge between Create: Deep Seas and Cosmonautics. Lets entities breathe normally while inside a sealed, unbreached, oxygenated sable sublevel.
body:
# About Cosmonautics: Deep Air
This mod simply adds localized air and gravity to cosmonautics using deep seas systems, this is just a temporary solution until air is added to cosmonautics standalone.

There is 1 major caveat to gravity, and that is atleast 1 room in your ship will need air due to deep sea memory cleanup.

# Dependencies

    Create
    Create Aeronautics
    Sable
    Cosmonautics
    Create: Deep Sea

** Optional, but one of the three is required. (Or any mod that allows the generation and transport of FE)

    Create Addition
    Create New Age
    Create Power Grid
